name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair MacLeod's journey into motorsport began in the Highlands, tinkering with engines on his family's farm. This practical experience fueled a passion for engineering, leading him to a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Edinburgh. After graduating, he started as a junior engineer at a small racing team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his keen eye for detail and ability to optimize performance.

At Signature Racing, Alistair is the linchpin of the team, ensuring that all operational aspects run smoothly. He's known for his data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing every aspect of the team's performance to identify areas for improvement. While a strong leader, Alistair prefers to lead by example, often found working late in the garage alongside the engineers and mechanics. His ability to foster a collaborative environment makes him a highly respected figure within the team.

What sets Alistair apart is his relentless pursuit of efficiency. He's constantly seeking innovative ways to streamline processes and maximize resource utilization, ensuring that Signature Racing operates at peak performance both on and off the track. His blend of technical expertise and managerial acumen makes him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
